main_measure.name: excess forward 20-bar return while short vs all bars

statistic.name: t of mean excess across non-overlapping short blocks

main_measure.threshold: t <= -2 with negative excess (and slope not positive) confirms; t >= +2 with positive excess rejects; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: slope of fwd 20-bar return on |forecast| within short bars (share of short blocks with negative excess reported in name)

decided_by: t lies between -2 and +2 (or is undefined), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a full 20-bar forward return, the baseline is the mean forward return over all such grid bars of the same window, the t is the ordinary t of the mean excess of short blocks, and the slope uses all short bars with forecast size taken as |forecast|.
